info.title: SolarWinds Service Desk
info.description: SolarWinds Service Desk (formerly Samanage) is a cloud-based IT service management platform covering incident, problem, change, asset, and service-catalog management.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 56 of 134 upstream operations. Covers Incident, Problem, and Change CRUD, Catalog Item browsing plus Service Request creation, Hardware and Other Asset CRUD, User/Group/Department/Site/Category CRUD, and comment create/update/delete on Incidents, Problems, and Changes. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

servers.description: US region. EU tenants use https://apieu.samanage.com, APJ tenants use https://apiau.samanage.com.
